# PDF.js

- Package: `pdfjs-dist`
- Version: `6.1.200`
- Project: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
- Distribution: https://www.npmjs.com/package/pdfjs-dist
- License: Apache License 2.0 (see `LICENSE`)

Only the browser display module, module worker, required WASM decoders, and standard fonts are included. No PDF.js viewer UI is used.
